summary: Specify personal composer input history across terminal, web and mobile clients

replay.detail: Documentation only; accepted messages and projection replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: The approved target contract describes a history read API; no wire schema or generated client changes are implemented.

rules.detail: No admission, authorization or checkpoint rules change at runtime.

compatibility.detail: No runtime changes; existing composer and client API behavior remains unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service or client is deployed or restarted.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this specification change.

recovery.detail: Documentation only; no live state requires recovery.
